**Ipswich Town (home) vs Aston Villa, Premier League, scheduled for 29 September 2024 at Portman Road.**[[1]](https://sports.yahoo.com/ipswich-vs-aston-villa-preview-230000679.html)[[2]](https://www.forebet.com/en/football/matches/ipswich-town-aston-villa-2090718)

This was Ipswich’s first Premier League season in 22 years after back-to-back promotions. Aston Villa were a established top-half side with Champions League participation in 2024–25.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024%E2%80%9325_Ipswich_Town_F.C._season)

### Head-to-Head History
Historical PL and league meetings heavily favour Aston Villa. In all-time Premier League encounters, Villa held a record of 7 wins, 4 draws, and 1 loss against Ipswich, with a positive goal difference.[[4]](https://www.statmuse.com/fc/ask?q=Aston+Villa+stats+vs+Ipswich+in+Premier+League+all-time) Ipswich won only 1 of the 13 meetings referenced in one source (Villa 7 wins, 5 draws).[[5]](https://m.aiscore.com/head-to-head/soccer-aston-villa-vs-ipswich-town)

Villa’s home league record against Ipswich was particularly strong; Ipswich lost 10 of their last 12 away league games against them, with the exceptions being two 1-0 wins (one in March 1994).[[6]](https://www.facebook.com/groups/777182403007382/posts/1676062339786046/) The most recent prior top-flight meetings dated to the mid-1990s (e.g., Villa wins or draws in 1994).[[7]](https://www.11v11.com/teams/aston-villa/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Ipswich%20Town/)[[8]](https://www.premierleague.com/en/match/13834) Villa had not visited Portman Road since 2018 (a Championship-era match).[[9]](https://www.avfc.co.uk/news/2024/september/27/team-news-for-ipswich-encounter/)

### Recent Form/Results (Pre-29 Sep 2024)
- **Ipswich**: After opening PL losses to Liverpool (0-2 home) and Manchester City (1-4 away), they earned a 1-1 home draw vs Fulham (Liam Delap goal), a 0-0 away draw at Brighton, and a 1-1 away draw at Southampton (Sam Morsy 95th-minute equaliser on 21 Sep). They were unbeaten in their last three league games and on a four-match unbeaten streak entering late September, sitting around mid-to-lower table.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024%E2%80%9325_Ipswich_Town_F.C._season)[[10]](https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/late-morsy-strike-earns-ipswich-1-1-draw-southampton-2024-09-21/)
- **Aston Villa**: Strong overall form as a top Premier League side with European commitments; specific pre-match results were not detailed in available pre-29 Sep sources beyond their general standing and squad depth. ### Injuries and Suspensions
- **Aston Villa** (as of 27 Sep 2024 team news): Centre-back Tyrone Mings and midfielder Boubacar Kamara (both recovering from long-term knee injuries) had returned to training with the group but were ruled out for the Ipswich match as it came too soon.[[9]](https://www.avfc.co.uk/news/2024/september/27/team-news-for-ipswich-encounter/)[[9]](https://www.avfc.co.uk/news/2024/september/27/team-news-for-ipswich-encounter/)
- **Ipswich**: An injury update from manager Kieran McKenna was issued on 12 Sep 2024 regarding the squad’s fitness; specific names were limited in pre-match sources, with defender Harry Clarke (Achilles) noted as progressing in training but not yet ready (targeted return potentially October).[[11]](https://www.itfc.co.uk/news/2024/september/12/injury-update-from-the-boss/)[[12]](https://www.foxsports.com/soccer/kyle-jameson-3-player)

### Travel, Fatigue, Venue, and Home Advantage
- **Venue**: Portman Road (Ipswich home). Standard English football stadium conditions; no notable pre-match reports on pitch quality, altitude (sea-level), or specific climate issues for late September. Stadium upgrades were underway ahead of the PL return.[[13]](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjjejx72zg2o)
- **Travel/Fatigue**: Short domestic trip for Villa from the Birmingham area (~150 miles/2–3 hours by road). No significant fatigue concerns noted. Ipswich played their prior match on 21 Sep (Southampton draw), allowing recovery time before the 29 Sep fixture. - **Crowd/Home Advantage**: Strong home support expected for Ipswich in their first PL season, with excitement around hosting a European-chasing side. Villa last visited in 2018.[[9]](https://www.avfc.co.uk/news/2024/september/27/team-news-for-ipswich-encounter/)

### Other Notable Storylines
- Ipswich under Kieran McKenna were competitive in early PL fixtures against stronger sides, showing resilience with late equalisers and clean sheets.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024%E2%80%9325_Ipswich_Town_F.C._season)
- Villa entered with European commitments (Champions League group stage), potentially affecting squad rotation, though pre-match previews highlighted a strong predicted XI including Emiliano Martínez, Ezri Konsa, and Ollie Watkins.[[1]](https://sports.yahoo.com/ipswich-vs-aston-villa-preview-230000679.html)
- This was one of the earlier “newly promoted vs established side” tests of the season. All details above derive exclusively from information available or published before 29 September 2024. Actual match outcomes or later developments were disregarded.

factors.factor: Aston Villa's superior league standing and squad quality
factors.impact: Significantly favors Aston Villa, as an established top-half Premier League team with Champions League participation against a newly promoted side.
Heavily favors Aston Villa with a dominant record (7 wins, 4 draws, 1 loss in PL). While dating back to the mid-1990s, it indicates a historical superiority.

Moderately favors Ipswich, having earned three consecutive league draws against established sides (Fulham, Brighton, Southampton) and showing resilience, including a late equalizer. They are unbeaten in their last three league games.
Moderately favors Ipswich, playing at Portman Road with strong support and excitement in their first Premier League season in 22 years.
Slightly disfavors Aston Villa, with key centre-back Tyrone Mings and midfielder Boubacar Kamara remaining out from long-term knee injuries, despite returning to training.
Potentially disfavors Aston Villa, as Champions League participation could lead to squad rotation or accumulated fatigue, though a strong predicted XI is noted.

analysis.reasoning: Aston Villa is the stronger side entering this fixture, holding a significantly higher league standing, superior squad quality, and historical dominance over Ipswich Town in past Premier League encounters. This provides a strong baseline favoring Villa. However, Ipswich Town has demonstrated remarkable resilience in their recent Premier League outings, securing draws against established teams like Fulham, Brighton, and Southampton, and are on a three-match unbeaten streak in the league. Their home advantage at Portman Road, fueled by excitement for their return to the top flight, will also be a factor. Aston Villa's continued absence of key players Mings and Kamara, alongside potential rotation considerations due to Champions League commitments, slightly temper their overall advantage. While Villa remains the clear favorite, Ipswich's recent form and home backing suggest they will be a competitive opponent, leading to a moderate adjustment in favor of Aston Villa rather than a substantial one.
